scope: Offline whole-ROI boundary candidates, shared curve-family association and historical free-rope profile refinement
comparison: v2/all_002 on identical images, reference ROI and original orientation
development_plan: Module smoke runs use only named entries of the fixed 38-image QA plan; preserve each run. Integration runs use all fixed 38 images, at most three algorithm revisions before selecting a frozen full run.
budget: CPU only, existing environment/models, no training or dependency changes. One frozen 400-image run after fixed QA; corrections require a new run directory and explanation.
continue_gate: All 38 complete with no pixel contract errors; visual review across both cameras, glare, stopping and ruler groups must show added coherent visible valleys and no new obvious long free-rope false tracks. No claimed precision/recall without independent labels. Disagreement and rejected regions remain recorded.
observation: Whole reference ROI scanning, no v1/v2 observation coordinates or lattice IDs supplied to detector; image pitch may be reused as a scale prior, not row identity
inference: Separate purple geometric proposals only, with observed endpoints and shared family support. Limited overlap with supported active-rope mask permitted only as explicitly tagged inferred-under-occlusion; unknown mask and reference-ROI exterior remain empty.
pixel_contract: All masks uint8 0/255. Observed subset of reference ROI minus supported/unknown exclusion. Inferred subset of reference ROI minus unknown and observed. RGB retained exactly inside effective ROI, black outside. Original reference ROI and source images unchanged.
metrics: Observation sample counts and agreement distances to v2 are descriptive coverage, not truth. Report both camera/source groups, refusals, historical detector attempts/success/fallback and geometric proposals. Fragment IDs are not rope material identities.
reserved_inputs: No 2026-09-25 or other reserved images/videos/labels decoded or used
devices: No camera, light, PLC, relay, line arm or servo access; no deployment
